input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: perf: slowest venture suite (league-schedule-generator), floor-priced test file
errors: Kept a per-file timing loop running while benchmarking, so the first eleven file times and the first tracker benchmark were taken under CPU contention; re-measured the decision numbers with nothing else running.
Ran `pkill -f` without bracketing the first letter; the hook refused it (CLAUDE.md warns about this). Used TaskStop instead.

doc_friction.issue: Ranked 'an incremental delta for the three move types' as the next large step; measured here, it is slower at 10 to 30 teams, because the 4e7/N^2 iteration budget already keeps each recount tiny. The new note records the negative result so later runs skip it.

'Where to look' item 3 (a venture's test suite) gives no per-file timing recipe; a one-line `for f in *.test.mjs; do time node --test $f; done` with a warning to run nothing else meanwhile would have saved a contended first reading.

deviations.why: Verify-and-merge suggests `run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes`; it lists 140 steps in 9 workflows for a test-only and docs change.
deviations.did: Relied on PR CI for the workflow checks, and ran the one changed test file (18/18 pass) myself before and after.

goal: Cut the critical path of the slowest venture test suite without changing any answer
notes: Metric: wall of `node --test --test-reporter=tap floor-priced.test.mjs` (the suite's longest file), same 4-core container, nothing else running, bash `time`. Before (main a09f3ce3e) 132.5 s wall / 128.8 s user; after 103.1 s / 99.6 s (-22%); 18 pass 0 fail both. Suite context: 24 files sum about 456 s, so this file was the longest and set the floor on wall time with 3 files at once. Negative result, not landed: an exact incremental carry-over tracker in anneal produced hash-identical output (sha256 of 16 carryOverTry + 6 bestCarryOverRounds results matched main) but was slower: 33.5 s vs 25.0 s on the mixed benchmark; lowCarryOverRounds at 10/14/22/30 teams 449/463/359/534 ms vs 339/282/408/552 ms. A round-major coeOf was neutral (53.1 s vs 52.9 s on 30 tries).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
